newsitem.title: UK: BP's Ruhrgas deal worth $1.0 bln -- report.
newsitem.headline: BP's Ruhrgas deal worth $1.0 bln -- report.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc agreed to a $1.0 billion deal to supply North Sea Gas to Germany's Ruhrgas, the Times newspaper reported on Monday.
The agreement would take North Sea gas to continental Europe via the Interconnector pipeline now under construction from the Norfolk coast to Zeebrugge, Belgium, the report said.
"This deal is the confirmation of the opportunities that now exist for UK gas trading on a Europe-wide basis," Rodney Chase, chief executive of BP exploration, was quoted as saying.
The newspaper also said BP's share of Britain's commercial and industrial gas market had more than doubled to 15 percent since the restructuring of its marketing activities in Britain last August.
A BP spokesman could not immediately be reached for comment.
On Sunday, Ruhrgas officials in Germany said they had agreed to a 15-year deal with BP to buy 15 billion cubic metres of gas from 1998.
